blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Speech recognition (ASR) systems are usually compared by word error rate (WER) on recorded files, after punctuation, capital letters and number format are removed. In dictation, the audio is streamed live and the text goes into the user's message as written, so what matters is which mistakes the user has to fix. The test set, streamed to eleven ASR systems, comprises 106 scripted English dictations from one speaker (read in a quiet room, with a fan on, and whispered), 20 clips in each of eleven other language and dialect sets, and 400 recordings that join clips in two languages. Every error was sorted by a fixed rule into four levels: recognition, output formatting, language handling and, for the self-hosted models, audio dropped before the model. Systems with similar WER failed in different ways. Zoom Scribe and OpenAI's GPT-Live-Transcribe have almost the same WER on quiet English (7.4% and 7.3%), but 34.7% and 8.8% on whispered English. Zoom and both AssemblyAI models left out 26-28% of whispered words, and still 21-26% with their end-of-turn detection relaxed or off; seven other systems left out at most 3%. Qwen3-ASR's 32% came from the speech detection in our own deployment (6% when relaxed). Across 107 EARS speakers, the same four systems lost 7-31% of whispered words, while six others lost under 2%. With only English selected, Gemini, Deepgram and our self-hosted Whisper lost the non-English part of a two-language recording in 86-99% of recordings, against 33-46% with both languages selected, while GPT-Live-Transcribe, OpenAI's realtime Whisper and Meta lost it in at most 20%. Running Whisper behind a Silero voice activity detector that drops audio judged to be silence raised whispered WER from 10.1% to 51.4%. Most English results come from one read speaker. The code, the recordings, both references and every transcript are released.
blocks.zh: 语音识别(ASR)系统通常在录制的文件上按照词错误率(WER)进行比较,在标注后,大写字母和数字格式被删除. 在拼写中,音频被流传到直播中,文本按写法输入用户信息,所以重要的是用户必须修正哪些错误. 测试集分流到11个ASR系统,包括106个来自一个演讲者(在静室阅读,并配有风扇,低声播放)的英文脚本片段,另外11个其他语言和方言片段各有20个片段,以及400个以两种语言加入片段的录音。 每个错误都按固定规则排序为四个级别:识别,输出格式化,语言处理,对于自托管的模型,音频在模型之前下降. 类似WER的系统以不同的方式失败. Zoom Scribe和OpenAI的GPT-Live-Trancis在静音英语(7.4%和7.3%)上几乎一样的WER,但在低语英语上是34.7%和8.8%. Zoom和两个AssemblyAI模型都遗漏了26-8%的低语句,仍然有21-26%随着它们的末端检测放松或关闭;其他7个系统最多遗漏了3%. Qune3-ASR的32%来自我们自己部署中的语音检测(放松时为6%). 在107个EARS的演讲者中,同样的四个系统损失了7-31%的低语,另外六个系统损失不到2%。 仅选择英语,双子座,Deepgram和我们自办的Whisper在86%-99%的录音中丢失了两种语言录音的非英语部分,而选择两种语言的为33-46%,而GPT-Live-Trancis,OpenAI的实时Whisper和Meta则以最多20%的速度丢失. 在Silero语音活动探测器的背后运行Whisper,该探测器滴下被判断为沉默的音频,将WER从10.1%提高到51.4%. 多数英文成绩来自一名讲者。 代码,录音,参考文献和每份笔录都发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: This paper studies one use of ASR systems, referred to here as dictation : the user speaks a message, an email, a note or an instruction to an AI assistant, and the text is placed into another app. The transcript is the final product. Every error stays in the message unless the user finds it and corrects it, and correcting recognition errors is a large part of the cost of entering text by voice [ 1 ; 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 本文研究了ASR系统的一种用途,这里称为拼写:用户向AI助手讲信息,电子邮件,注释或指示,文本被放入另一个应用. 笔录为最终产品. 除非用户找到并改正,否则每条错误都会留在消息中,纠正识别错误是语音输入文本成本的很大一部分[1;2].

blocks.en: WER counts errors but does not say what kind they are. On a dictation of eleven sentences of similar length, a WER of 9% could mean one wrong word in every eleven, or one whole sentence missing from otherwise correct text. A single average can also hide large differences between groups of speakers [ 3 ] and between dialects [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: WER 计数错误,但不表示它们是什么类型 。 在11句类似长度的拼写中,9%的WER可能意味着每11句中有一个错误的词,或者从其他正确文本中缺失一个完整的句子. 单一平均值也可以掩盖各语组之间[3]和方言[4]之间的巨大差异.

blocks.en: Public benchmarks run complete audio files through each system and report WER on normalised text [ 5 ; 6 ] . Dictation differs in four ways, each tested here: • The audio is streamed, so it is streamed at the speed of speech and the time to the final text after the audio ends is measured. • The text is used as written, so numbers are scored as written and errors in punctuation and capital letters are also reported. • People dictate in different conditions, so English is recorded in a quiet room, with a fan on and in a whisper. • People dictate in other languages and mix languages, so 11 language and dialect sets covering 7 languages are tested, along with recordings that switch from one language to another.
blocks.zh: 公共基准通过每个系统运行完整的音频文件,并以正常化文本报告WER[5;6]. 拼写方式有四种不同,每种方式在此测试: 音频是流传的,因此以语音的速度流传,并测量音频结尾后的时间到最终文本. ^ 文字作为书写使用,所以数字被打成书写,并且还报告了标注和大写字母中的错误. ·人们在不同的条件下发号施令,所以英语被录制在一个安静的房间,上面和耳语中都有扇子. • 人们用其他语言来决定和混合语言,因此测试了涵盖7种语言的11种语言和方言,以及从一种语言切换到另一种语言的录音。

blocks.en: The audio is streamed, so it is streamed at the speed of speech and the time to the final text after the audio ends is measured.
blocks.zh: 音频是流传的,因此其流传速度为语音速度,在音频结尾被测量后的时间为最终文本.

blocks.en: The text is used as written, so numbers are scored as written and errors in punctuation and capital letters are also reported.
blocks.zh: 文字作为书写使用,所以数字被打成书写,并且还报告了标注和大写字母中的错误.

blocks.en: People dictate in different conditions, so English is recorded in a quiet room, with a fan on and in a whisper.
blocks.zh: 人们在不同的条件下发号施令,所以英语被录制在一个安静的房间里,一个风扇上和低语中.

blocks.en: People dictate in other languages and mix languages, so 11 language and dialect sets covering 7 languages are tested, along with recordings that switch from one language to another.
blocks.zh: 人们用其他语言来决定和混合语言,因此包括7种语言的11种语言和方言集都经过测试,还有从一种语言切换到另一种语言的录音.

blocks.en: Eleven systems are tested: two self-hosted open models and nine services run by their providers. Every transcript is lined up with the correct text word by word, and each error is sorted by a fixed rule into one of four groups, called levels : recognition, output formatting, language handling, and the audio path before the model (Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 测试了11个系统:2个自行托管的开放模型和9个由其提供者经营的服务. 每段笔录逐字排列正确文字,每段错误按固定规则排序为四组之一,称为:识别,输出格式,语言处理,以及模型前的音频路径(第3节).

blocks.en: The main finding is that systems with similar WER fail in different ways, and that the differences are large. Zoom and GPT-Live have almost the same quiet-English WER (7.4% and 7.3%), but on whispered English Zoom leaves out 28% of words and GPT-Live 1%. With only English selected, some systems remove the other language of a two-language recording almost every time and others keep it. And the app around the model matters: running Whisper behind a voice activity detector that drops audio it judges to be silence raised its whispered WER from 10.1% to 51.4%.
blocks.zh: 主要的发现是,具有类似WER的系统以不同的方式失败,差异很大. Zoom和GPT-Live几乎有相同的静音-英语WER(7.4%和7.3%),但在低语的英语Zoom上,GPT-Live漏掉了28%的单词和GPT-Live 1%. 由于只选英语,有些系统几乎每次都去掉两种语言录音的其他语言,有些系统则保留. 而该模型周围的应用很重要:在声音活动探测器后面运行Whisper,该探测器将音频滴下,它判断是静默,将其低语的WER从10.1%提升到51.4%。

blocks.en: The paper makes four contributions: • A failure taxonomy for streaming dictation that groups error types by the level they show up at, with a stated rule for detecting each type (Section 3 ). • A per-level comparison of eleven systems on in-house data and on two external corpora with many speakers, including two behaviours known for open models [ 7 ; 8 ; 9 ] that, to our knowledge, have not been measured for commercial streaming systems: a language setting that removes the other language for some systems and only guides the language for others, and output in the wrong writing system (Sections 5 – 8 ). • Two references for the same speech : the script the speaker meant (the script reference ) and a record of what they said (the spoken reference ), which separate a system that hears every word from one that writes the intended message (Section 7.3 ). • A case study of the level before the model : nine ways of running Whisper that differ in hosting, in how the audio is cut, in which voice activity detector (VAD) is used, and in whether the VAD drops audio before the model (Section 9 ). The test client, the analysis code, the English recordings, both references and every system’s transcripts are released.
blocks.zh: 论文有四点贡献: 流线拼音的失败分类法,即按显示的级别分组错误类型,并附有探测每种类型的规则(第3节)。 将11个关于内部数据和两个外部公司的系统与许多发言者进行逐级比较,包括两种以开放模式而闻名的行为[7;8;9]。 据我们所知,这两种行为没有为商业流线系统加以衡量:一种语言设置,将某些系统的其他语言删除,仅指导其他系统的语言,在错误的书写系统中输出(第5至8节)。 同一发言有两处参考:演讲者的意思(脚本参考)和他们所说的话的记录(口语参考),其中将一个能听到每个字的系统与写意向信息的系统分开(第7.3节)。 模型前的关卡的案例研究: 运行Whisper的九种方式,在托管,音频的剪切方式,语音活动探测器(VAD)的用法,以及VAD是否在模型之前降音(第9节)方面有所不同. 测试客户端,分析码,英语录音,参考文献和每个系统的笔录都发布.

blocks.zh: 以显示的级别来分组错误类型,并附有用于检测每个类型的规则(第3节)。

blocks.zh: 同一发言有两个参考词:演讲者的意思(脚本参考词)和他们所说的话的记录(口头参考词),其中将一个能听到每个字的系统与写意向信息的系统分开(第7.3节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Public leaderboards test open models and commercial services on complete audio files from public datasets, and clean up the text first so that differences in formatting do not count as errors [ 6 ; 5 ] . Independent tests of commercial services stream audio at the speed of speech and report speed alongside accuracy [ 10 ] . WER depends on how the text is normalised and on the test data [ 11 ] , and WER on one test set is a poor guide to WER on others [ 12 ] . Other measures look past WER: match error rate and word information lost [ 13 ] , semantic distance between reference and transcript [ 14 ] , scores that split hallucinations by kind [ 15 ] , and rates of runs of inserted or deleted words per hour [ 16 ] . Error analysis has shown which words are hard to recognise, such as rare words and words near disfluencies [ 17 ] , and work on detecting and correcting ASR errors is reviewed by Errattahi et al. [18] . Error categories close to ours have been applied to Whisper on South Asian languages, where output in the wrong writing system caused most failures in three of four languages [ 9 ] . Wrong-script output has also been measured across many model–language pairs [ 8 ] and removed from WER by mapping both texts to one script [ 19 ] . These studies test open models. Some benchmarks score text closer to how it is written: ESB keeps casing and punctuation [ 20 ] , LibriSpeech-PC scores punctuation and capital letters [ 21 ] , and Earnings-21 reports accuracy on named entities [ 22 ] . Most of these report how many errors a system makes on complete files. This work reports what kinds of errors commercial systems make in a streaming dictation setting, scoring the text as the user receives it, without converting numbers to a common form.
blocks.zh: 公共领导板从公共数据集测试完整音频文件中的开放模型和商业服务,并首先清理文本,使格式上的差别不计为错误[6;5]. 对商业服务流音频进行独立测试,以语音速度和报告速度与准确度并列[10]. WER取决于文本的正常化方式和测试数据[11],而一个测试集的WER是WER在其他测试 [12] 上的不良指南. 其它措施则参照过WER:匹配误差率和损失的字词信息 [13],参考与笔录之间的语义距离 [14],按类型划分幻觉的分数 [15],以及插入或删除的单词每小时的运行率 [16]. 错误分析显示哪些单词难以识别,如稀有单词和接近疏漏的单词[17],发现和纠正ASR错误的工作由Errattahi等人审查. [18] (中文(简体) ). 与我们相近的错误分类被应用于南亚语言的Whisper,在错误的书写系统中输出导致四种语言中三种的多数失败[9]. 在许多模型-语言对[8]中也测量了错误的标注输出,并通过将两种文本映射到一个脚本[19]来从WER中删除. 这些研究测试开放模型. 一些基准得分文本更接近其写法:ESB保持外壳和标点[20],LibriSpeech-PC分数和大写字母[21],Ennings-21报告点名实体的准确性[22]. 其中大多数报告一个系统在完整文件中有多少错误。 这项工作报告了商业系统在流传的拼写设置中的各种错误,在用户收到时对文本进行评分,而不将数字转换成共同形式.

blocks.en: In a study of short messages on phones, speech entry was about three times faster than typing, with slightly more errors left in the final text [ 2 ] . The delay a user feels depends on how fast text is emitted and on endpointing, the decision that the speaker has stopped [ 23 ] , and partial text can change before it is final [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 在一项对电话短信息的研究中,语音条目比打字快约3倍,最后文本中留下的差错略多[2]. 用户感到的延迟取决于文本的发布速度和端点、发言者停止的决定[23],以及部分文本在最后[24]之前可以更改。

blocks.en: FLEURS [ 25 ] and VoxPopuli [ 26 ] provide read speech and parliament speeches in many languages. Arabic dialects remain much harder for current systems than Modern Standard Arabic [ 4 ; 27 ] . Arabic dialects also have no standard spelling, which has led to spelling conventions [ 28 ] and to scoring against several correct texts [ 29 ] . Urdu ASR has been benchmarked on read and conversational speech [ 30 ] . Urdu is also often written in Latin letters (Roman Urdu), and converting code-mixed Roman Urdu back to Urdu script is a task of its own [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: FLEURS [25]和VoxPopuli [26] 提供多种语言的阅读演说和议会演说. 与现代标准阿拉伯语[4;27]相比,目前系统的阿拉伯语方言仍然困难得多. 阿拉伯语方言也没有标准的拼写方式,这导致了拼写惯例[28],对数个正确文本的评分[29]. 乌尔都语ASR以阅读和谈话演说为基准 [30]. 乌尔都语也常用拉丁字母写成(罗马乌尔都语),将编码混合的罗马乌尔都语回译为乌尔都语脚本是其自身的任务[31].

blocks.en: Code-switching, moving between languages between or within sentences [ 32 ] , has long been hard for speech and language technology [ 33 ] . Existing corpora, such as SEAME [ 34 ] and ASCEND [ 35 ] for Mandarin and English, contain natural switches within a sentence, for a few language pairs. For Whisper, the language given in the prompt changes code-switched output, and a single language can lead it to write a translation instead of a transcript [ 7 ] . WER over a whole recording can hide errors on the switched words, which has led to scoring only those words [ 36 ] . The recordings used here instead switch between sentences, for many language pairs. These recordings are less natural, but they reduce the chance that a language was lost because it is hard on its own.
blocks.zh: 代码切换,在句子之间或句子之内在语言之间移动[32],对语言和语言技术来说长期以来一直很困难[33]. 现存的corpora,如普通话和英语的SEAME[34]和ASCEND[35],在一个句子内包含自然开关,为少数语言对. 对于Whisper来说,在即时更改代码切换输出中给出的语言,一个单一语言可以引导它写一个翻译而不是一个笔录[7]. 整个录制的WERR可以隐藏切换词上的错误,这使得这些词只得分[36]. 这里使用的录音在句子之间切换, 对于许多语言对换. 这些录音不太自然,但会减少一种语言因为自身困难而丢失的机会.

blocks.en: Whispered speech has no voicing and is much harder for recognisers trained on normal speech [ 37 ] ; work on whispered ASR adapts models to it, for example with synthetic pseudo-whisper training data [ 38 ] . Corpora with whispered readings include wTIMIT [ 37 ] , CHAINS [ 39 ] , AISHELL6-Whisper for Mandarin [ 40 ] and EARS [ 41 ] , which records the same text read normally and whispered by 107 speakers; EARS is used here to compare the systems across speakers.
blocks.zh: 低声演讲没有发声,对于接受过普通演讲培训的识别者来说,更难听;关于低声演讲的ASR的工作使模型适应它,例如合成伪低声培训数据[38]. 带有低声读数的Corpora包括wTIMIT [37],CHAINS [39],普通话的ASHELL6-Whisper [40]和EARS [41],它们记录了107位发言者通常读取并低声读取的相同文本;这里使用EARS来比较各发言者的系统.

blocks.en: 3 Failure Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3 失败分类

blocks.en: Table 1: The failure taxonomy: error types grouped by the level they show up at, with the field’s usual term in brackets, the rule used to detect each, and the section that measures it. The 50% bar for a failed clip is where half of the message would have to be retyped; the 30% bar for a hard clip counts a clip that needs several corrections; the 20% bar keeps a part with a few misheard words from counting as missing.
blocks.zh: 表1:故障分类法:按它们显示的级别分类的错误类型,括号内为字段的常用名词,用于检测每个字段的规则,以及测量它的部分. 一个失败的剪辑的50%栏是需要重排一半消息的地方;一个硬剪辑的30%栏计算出一个需要几处更正的剪辑;20%栏保留了部分内容,少数错误的单词不被计算为缺失.

blocks.en:
Error types are grouped into four levels, by where in the pipeline the error shows up (Table 1 ): recognition (words missed, misheard or invented); output formatting (words recognised but written in a form the user did not intend, such as a number in words instead of digits, or text in the wrong writing system; inverse text normalisation , ITN, is the step that turns “seven” into “7” [ 42 ] ); language handling (one language of a two-language message dropped, written in Latin letters, or translated); and before the model (audio the app never sends to the system).
The levels describe what is observed in the output, not a proven cause. For the hosted services, a missing word could have been lost in the service’s own speech detection rather than in its model, and a language could be lost because of when the service finalises text rather than how it handles languages (Section 8 ). The level before the model can be separated from recognition only for the self-hosted models, Whisper and Qwen, whose audio path is under our control (Sections 6.2 and 9 ). Every result therefore describes a system together with our integration of it (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh:
错误类型分为四个级别,按照在管道中出现的错误(表1):识别(错失的、错误的或发明的词);输出格式(识别但以用户无意的形式写成的词,例如用字数表示数字,或用错误的写法系统写成文字);反向文本正常化(ITN)是将“七”变为“7”[42]”的步骤;语言处理(一种两种语言信息的一种语言,用拉丁字母写成,或翻译);以及模型之前(Audio这个应用程序从未向系统发送)。
这些水平描述的是产出中观察到的东西,而不是一个经过证明的原因. 对于主机服务来说,在服务本身的语音检测而不是其模型中可能会丢失一个缺失的单词,而且由于服务何时定稿而不是如何处理语言,语言可能会丢失(第8节)。 模式之前的关卡只能与自我托管的型号Whisper和Quen相分离,后者的音频路径由我们控制(第6.2和9节). 因此,每个结果都描述了一个系统及其整合(附录A)。

blocks.en: Each type has a stated rule that a program applies to the word-by-word comparison; the rules that rely on earlier judgements are listed in Section 11 .
blocks.zh: 每个类型都有一条声明的规则,即一个程序适用于逐字比较;依赖先前判决的规则列于第11节.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Eleven systems that transcribe in real time are tested. Two are self-hosted open models: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B [ 43 ] (“Qwen”) and Whisper Large V3 [ 5 ] (“Whisper SH”, self-hosted). Nine are run by their providers: Meta Muse Voice Transcribe (“Meta”); Gemini 3.5 Transcribe (Live API; “Gemini”); Deepgram Nova-3; AssemblyAI Universal-3.6 Pro and Universal-3.5 Pro (“AAI 3.6” and “AAI 3.5”); Zoom Scribe (Live API; “Zoom”); ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime (“ElevenLabs”); OpenAI GPT-Live-Transcribe (Realtime API; “GPT-Live”); and OpenAI GPT-Realtime-Whisper, OpenAI’s hosted streaming Whisper (“RT Whisper”). Section 9 compares nine ways of running Whisper; the main comparison uses two of them, Whisper SH and RT Whisper. All runs took place between 1 October and 5 November 2026 (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 11个实时转录的系统进行了测试. 两种是自备的开放模式: Qune3-ASR 1.7B [43] ("Quen")和Whiper Lige V3 [5] ("Whiper SH",自主办). 9个由供应商经营: 元数据 Muse语音转写(“Meta”);双子座3.5转写(“Live API;“Gemini”);Deepgram Nova-3;Assemali Universal-3.6 Pro和Universal-3.5 Pro(“AAI 3.6”和“AAI 3.5”));Zoom Scribe(Live API;“Zoom”);11Labs Scribe v2 Realtime(“ElevenLabs”);OpenAI GPT-Live-Trantics (Realtime API;“GPT-Live”);以及OpenAI托管的GPT-Realtime-Whisper(“RT Whisper”)。 第9节比较了运行Whisper的9种方式;主要比较使用了其中2种,Whisper SH和RT Whisper. 所有运行都在2026年10月1日至11月5日期间进行(附录A.

blocks.en: Each system is used with its default settings, with a few changes given in Appendix A . Each system is told the language a user would choose, as a language code without a region unless a system needs one; if a system has no option for that language, none is sent and the system detects the language itself. Sending each dialect’s own regional code, where a provider documents one, changed almost nothing (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 每个系统都使用其默认设置,附录A给出了一些修改。 每个系统都被告知用户会选择的语言,作为一个没有区域的语言代码,除非一个系统需要一个区域;如果一个系统无法选择该语言,则没有哪个系统发送,系统会探测语言本身. 发送每个方言自己的区域代码,其中一个提供方文档,几乎没有改变(附录A).

blocks.en: Gemini and ElevenLabs write every word as spoken by default, including fillers, repeats and false starts, and each offers a setting that removes them: Gemini’s Smart mode, which also adds punctuation, capital letters and structured formatting [ 44 ] , and ElevenLabs’ no_verbatim option [ 45 ] . These are reported as two extra rows, “Gemini Smart” and “ElevenLabs NV” (no verbatim), so the result tables have thirteen rows. Counts of errors that all systems share cover the eleven systems and leave these two rows out.
blocks.zh: 双子座和11Labs将每个字写成默认的,包括填充符,重复符和虚假的开始符,每个词都提供一个可以删除它们的设置:双子座的智能模式,它也添加了标点符,大写字母和结构格式[44],11Labs的 no_verbatim选项[45]. 这些表格作为“Gemini Smart”和“ElevenLabs NV”(无逐字记录)两行报告,结果表有13行。 所有系统共享的错误数覆盖了11个系统,并将这两行保留在外.

blocks.en: The in-house set consists of 106 English messages, written for the study to resemble chat, email, notes and prompts to AI assistants, and read aloud by one speaker, a member of the research team. Each message was recorded once, in one condition: 73 in a quiet room, 17 with a fan running nearby and 16 in a whisper. The three conditions use different messages, so systems are compared within a condition, not the conditions with each other; the fan-on set is a second set of read messages, not a test of noise. The third condition is called whispered speech ; the model is always named by its setup (for example Whisper SH), to keep the two apart. The reader deliberately moved between US, South Asian, British and Irish English, often within a message (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 内部集由106条英文留言组成,为研究写成,类似于聊天,电子邮件,笔记和提示给AI助手,并由一位演讲者,研究小组成员大声朗读. 每条信息都录制过一次,一个条件:73个在静室,17个在附近有风扇奔跑,16个在低语中. 三个条件使用不同的消息,因此系统在一个条件范围内比较,而不是相互比较条件;扇形集是第二组读音消息,而不是测试噪音. 第三个条件叫做低语语音 ; 模型总是由其设置来命名(例如Whisper SH),以保持两者的区别. 读者故意在美,南亚,英国和爱尔兰英语之间移动,常在一条消息(附录C)内.

blocks.en: Each English message has two correct texts. The script reference is the text the reader was given: what they meant to send. The spoken reference is what they actually said, made by correcting the script against the audio. The two differ in 85 of the 106 messages, by 453 of 10,776 words (4.2%): 242 added, 88 left out and 123 changed, including repeated words and spoken self-corrections. To make the spoken reference, a program proposed an edit wherever several systems heard the same departure from the script, and one listener accepted or rejected each proposal and corrected the rest by hand (Appendix B ). Unless stated otherwise, English results use the script reference, because it is what a dictation user wants on the screen; Section 7.3 compares the two.
blocks.zh: 每条英文电文有两个正确的文本。 脚本参考是读者得到的文本:他们的意思是发送. 口述的提法是他们实际上所说的,通过校正剧本而不是音频来表达的. 106条留言中有85条不同,有10,776个单词中的453个(4.2%):增加了242个,88个被忽略,123个被更改,包括重复的单词和口语自我纠正. 为了让口头引用,一个程序提议在几个系统听到相同的偏离脚本的地方进行编辑,一个听众接受或拒绝每个建议,并用手纠正其余的建议(附录B ). 除非另有说明,英语结果使用脚本参考,因为这是拼写用户在屏幕上想要的;第7.3节比较两者.

blocks.en: Twenty short clips were taken from each of 11 language and dialect sets in public datasets (Table 2 ). From these, 400 recordings were built that join two clips in different languages (Section 8 ). Ten clips with no speech are also included (silence and background noise) to check whether a system writes text when nobody is speaking. The single-language clips add up to 99 minutes of speech.
blocks.zh: 从公共数据集的11种语言和方言集中各取了20个短片(表2)。 制作400张录音, 包括十个没有发言的片段(沉默和背景噪音), 单语片段累计99分钟的语音.

blocks.en: Two public corpora with many speakers repeat the whispering and noise tests: EARS and VOiCES (Sections 6.2 and 6.5 , Appendix E ). They are kept apart from the in-house data and scored differently.
blocks.zh: 两个公开公司和许多发言者重复耳语和噪音测试:ELS和VOICES(附录E第6.2和6.5节)。 它们与内部数据分开,得分不同。

blocks.en: Table 2: The test data: number of clips or recordings in each set.
blocks.zh: 表2:测试数据:每集的剪辑或录音数量.

blocks.en: Each clip is streamed at the speed of speech in small chunks, the way a microphone delivers it, with a new session for every clip and all systems called from the same client machine (Appendix A ). A system finalises text when it commits to it and stops revising it; only finalised text is scored.
blocks.zh: 每个片段以小块的语音速度,麦克风的传送方式流出,每个片段和从同一个客户机调用的所有系统(Appendix A.)都有一个新的会话. 一个系统在承诺时会最终完成文本,并停止修订;只有最终文本才得分.

blocks.en: A voice activity detector (VAD) is a small model that decides whether audio contains speech. Except where Section 9 says otherwise, no VAD drops any audio: every system receives every sample. Whisper SH uses Silero VAD [ 48 ] only to decide where to cut the audio into segments. Section 9 measures what happens when a VAD also drops audio, using a second Whisper deployment of ours with a VAD in front of it on the client (“gated Whisper”).
blocks.zh: 一个语音活动探测器(VAD)是一个决定音频是否包含语音的小模型. 除非第9节另有说明,否则VAD不会丢掉任何音频:每个系统都会收到每个样本. Whisper SH使用Silero VAD [48] 只是为了决定将音频剪切到哪个部分. 第9节测量当一个VAD也降下音频时会发生什么,使用在客户端上用一个VAD前方的第二次Whiper部署我们的"Whiper"("Whiper").

blocks.en: Before a transcript is compared with the correct text, capital letters and punctuation are ignored, and variant letter forms in Arabic, Urdu and Chinese are treated as equal (Appendix B ). Numbers are not converted: the text is scored as written, so “seven” in place of “7” counts as an error.
blocks.zh: 在将笔录与正确的文字进行比较之前,大写字母和标点字母被忽略,阿拉伯语,乌尔都语和汉语的变体字母表被作为等价(附录B. 数字不转换:正文按文字打分,所以“7”代替“7”算作错误。

blocks.en: Each transcript is lined up with the correct text (the reference) using the fewest possible edits (a Levenshtein alignment). This gives three kinds of word error: a substitution (a wrong word), a deletion (a missing word) and an insertion (an extra word). WER is the total number of errors in a set divided by the total number of words in its correct text. It can exceed 100%, because extra words also count as errors. Mandarin, which is not written with spaces, is scored by counting each Chinese character as one unit (Appendix B ). The character error rate (CER) is the same measure counted over characters. A formatted error rate is also reported, a case- and punctuation-sensitive WER as in ESB [ 20 ] : words keep their capital letters and each punctuation mark counts as a separate token, so a wrong capital or a missing comma each counts as one error.
blocks.zh: 每张笔录都用尽可能少的编辑(Levenshtein对齐)与正确的文本(参考)排成一行. 这给出了三种词错误:替换(一个错误的词),删除(一个缺失的词)和插入(一个额外的词). WER是一组中错误的总数除以其正确文本中的单词总数. 它可以超过100%,因为额外的单词也算作错误. 普通话没有空格的写法,通过将每个汉字字符计为一个单位(附录B)来评分. 字符错误率(CER)是计算在字符之上的同一度量. 还报告了格式化错误率,ESB [20] 中的大小写和标点灵敏的WER:单词保留其大写字母和每个标点符号作为单独的符号计数,所以一个错误的大写或一个缺失的逗号每个计数为一个错误.

blocks.en: English WER is given with a 95% confidence interval from a percentile bootstrap over clips with 2,000 resamples [ 49 ] (4,000 for the significance tests). These intervals describe variation across messages, not across speakers. When two systems, or one system under two conditions, are compared, the same clips are resampled for both (a paired comparison). A difference is clear when the 95% interval of the paired difference excludes zero and it still holds after a Holm correction for the number of comparisons in its group (for example, the 13 name gaps form one group; Appendix B ); otherwise it is within chance . The language sets have only 20 clips each, so differences of a few points there are within chance. Differences are given in percentage points (“points”).
blocks.zh: English WER的置信间隔为95%,从一个百分位的靴子夹到2000个复刻[49](4 000个用于意义测试)的夹片。 这些间隔说明不同信息之间的差异,而不是发言者之间的差异。 当比较两个系统,或两个条件下的一个系统时,同样的剪辑会被重新标注为两个系统(一个配对比较). 当配对差异的95%间距排除0,并且在Holm校正其组中的比较数(例如,13个名称间隙组成一个组;附录B)之后仍然维持时,一个差异就很明显了;否则它就有可能存在。 语言集每集只有20个片段,所以几分的差异是偶然的. 百分比(“点”)有差异。

blocks.en: 5 Overall Results
blocks.zh: 5 总体结果

blocks.en: Table 3 gives each system’s WER and formatted error rate for each English condition. On quiet English, ten of the thirteen rows are between 3.9% and 9.5%, and the order of these systems tells little about the other conditions. Zoom (7.4%) and GPT-Live (7.3%) are the clearest case: on whispered English, Zoom’s WER is 34.7% and GPT-Live’s 8.8% (paired difference 25.8 points, 95% CI 10.3 to 51.7), almost all of it missing words. AAI 3.6 (8.2%) and RT Whisper (8.2%) are another: 30.5% and 8.9% whispered. Gemini Smart has the lowest quiet-English WER (3.9%), clearly below the next row, ElevenLabs NV; the lowest with default settings is Gemini, at 6.9%. When capital letters and punctuation are also scored, error rates on quiet English rise to 8.8–22.8%; Gemini Smart (8.8%), ElevenLabs NV (9.0%) and Gemini (9.1%) are lowest.
blocks.zh: 表3列出每个系统的WER和格式化的每个英语条件错误率。 在静静的英语中,十三行中有十行在3.9%到9.5%之间,这些系统的顺序几乎没有说明其他条件. Zoom(7.4%)和GPT-Live(7.3%)是最清楚的案例:在低语英语中,Zoom的WER为34.7%,GPT-Live为8.8%(差值为25.8分,95%为CI 10.3至51.7分),几乎全部缺词. AAI 3.6(8.2%)和RT Whisper(8.2%)是另一种说法:30.5%和8.9%。 双子智能拥有最低的静音-英语WER(3.9%),明显低于下一行,11Labs NV;默认设置的最低是双子智能,为6.9%. 当大写字母和标点符号也得分时,静音英语的误差率上升到8.8–22.8%;双子智能(8.8%),11Labs NV(9.0%)和双子智能(9.1%)最低.

blocks.en: Table 3: English error rates (%), lower is better. WER is shown with its 95% confidence interval. Bold: clearly below the next-lowest system (paired bootstrap); this holds only for quiet-English WER. Formatted: WER that also counts mistakes in capital letters and punctuation.
blocks.zh: 表3:英语误差率(%),下调较好. WER以95%的置信间隔显示. 粗体:明显低于次低的系统(paired bootstrap);这只用于静音-英语WER. 格式化:同样计算大写字母和标点符号错误的WER.

blocks.en: For European languages and Mandarin the systems are close, and most stay below 10%. Hindi ranges from 2.6% to 34.6%, Urdu is above 85% for several systems (Section 7.2 ), and the Saudi and Emirati Arabic sets are hard for every system (Section 6.4 ). No system is clearly best on any language set. Appendix D gives WER for each set (Table 15 ).
blocks.zh: 对于欧洲语言和普通话来说,这些系统是接近的,大多数都保持在10%以下。 印地语从2.6%到34.6%不等,若干系统乌尔都语高于85%(第7.2节),沙特语和阿联酋语的阿拉伯语集对每个系统都很难(第6.4节)。 没有任何系统在任何语言设置上都明显是最好的. 附录D提供了每套软件的WER(表15)。

blocks.en: Measured from our test client, typical (median) waits from the end of the audio to the final text range from 313 to 760 ms. Meta, Deepgram, Whisper SH, Qwen and both ElevenLabs settings wait under 400 ms; GPT-Live and RT Whisper about 750 ms. Appendix D.1 gives the full timings, which should be treated as indicative.
blocks.zh: 从我们的测试客户端衡量,典型的(中间)从音频结尾到最终文本的等待范围从313到760ms不等. Meta, Deepgram, Whisper SH, Quen 和 两者都是11 实验室设置在400ms以下等待;GPT-Live和RTWhisper大约750ms. 附录D.1列出了全部时间安排,应将其视为指示性的。

blocks.en: 6 Recognition Errors
blocks.zh: 6 识别错误

blocks.en: 6.1 Substitutions, Deletions and Insertions
blocks.zh: 6.1 替代、删除和插入

blocks.en: WER adds three kinds of error together: wrong words (substitutions), missing words (deletions) and extra words (insertions). Table 4 splits each system’s WER into these three parts for quiet English, English with the fan on, and the other languages.
blocks.zh: WER增加了三类错误:错误的词(替代),缺失的词(删除)和额外的词(插入). 表4将每个系统的WER分成这三部分,用于静默的英语、带有风扇的英语以及其他语言。

blocks.en: Table 4: Wrong, missing and extra words (substitutions, deletions, insertions) against the script reference, each as a share (%) of all words in the correct text. For each English condition, the three add up to the WER, give or take 0.1 for rounding. Other languages: the 10 non-English sets other than Urdu, pooled by words, so the sum differs slightly from the per-set average in Table 15 (Urdu errors are mostly the wrong writing system; Section 7.2 ).
blocks.zh: 表4:对脚本引用的错,缺和额外单词(替代,删除,插入),每个单词作为正确文本中所有单词的共享(%). 对于每个英语条件,三个加成WER,给予或接受0.1进行四舍五入. 其他语言:乌尔都语以外的10种非英语的集词,所以总和与表15中的每套平均值略有不同(乌尔都语错误大多是错误的书写系统;第7.2节).

blocks.en: Against the script reference, extra words are the largest part of the error for nine of the thirteen rows: Gemini, for example, has 3.7% extra words against 2.1% wrong ones, and ElevenLabs 8.1% against 2.8%. Many of these extra words were really said: they are repeats and self-corrections the reader added. Against the spoken reference, extra words are the largest part for only four rows (Gemini, AAI 3.5, Zoom and ElevenLabs): Gemini’s extra words fall from 3.7% to 1.6%, but ElevenLabs’ only to 5.7%, so most of ElevenLabs’ extra words were not said. The mix also differs between systems with the same WER. Whisper SH and AAI 3.6 (8.3% and 8.2%) differ by only 0.1 points in WER, but Whisper SH misses more words (by 0.9 points, 95% CI 0.1 to 2.4) and adds fewer (by 1.1 points, 95% CI 0.5 to 1.8). Missing words are between 1.1% and 2.7% for every system.
blocks.zh: 相对于脚本引用,额外字是13行中9行错误中最大的部分:例如双子座的附加字数为3.7%,而错误的为2.1%;11Labs 8.1%,而错误的为2.8%. 这些额外的词中有许多是真的说:它们是重复的,是读者所加的自我修正. 与口述参考相反,仅四行(Gemini、AAI 3.5、Zoom和11Labs)的附加词最多: 双子座的附加词从3.7%下降到1.6 %,但11Labs的附加词只有5.7 %,因此11Labs的额外词大多没有说. 混合方式也因系统不同而异,采用相同的WER. 微声SH和AAI 3.6(8.3%和8.2%)在WER中只有0.1分不同,但Whisper SH少了更多的单词(0.9分,95%CI 0.1至2.4),加得更少(1.1分,95%CI 0.5至1.8). 每个系统缺失的字数在1.1%至2.7%。

blocks.en: On the fan-on set, wrong words are the largest part for all thirteen rows; Deepgram has the most, 7.0%. Outside English, wrong words are also the largest part for every system: 7.6–13.1% of words, against 1.9–5.7% missing and 0.5–1.2% extra.
blocks.zh: 在粉丝组合上,错字是所有十三行中最大的部分;Deepgram拥有最多,7.0%. 在英语之外,错误的词也是每个系统最大的部分:7.6–13.1%的词,而缺失1.9–5.7%,额外增加0.5–1.2%.

blocks.en: For every system, ordinary words are the largest group of wrong English words (46–63%). Numbers written as words instead of digits or the other way round (Section 7.1 ), and near-misses such as “request” for “requests”, together make up 33–50%; names are 3–5% (Appendix D , Table 19 ).
blocks.zh: 对于每个系统来说,普通词是最大的错误英语词组(46–63%). 数字作为字数而不是数字来写,或者用其他方式来写(第7.1节),以及 " 要求 " 等近似缺失数字,共占33-50%;名字为3-5%(附录D,表19)。

blocks.en: 6.2 Whispered Speech
blocks.zh: 6.2 低语发言

blocks.en: On whispered speech, Qwen, Zoom and both AAI models leave out 26–32% of words; every other row leaves out at most 3% (Figure 1 ). With 16 clips these shares are uncertain (for Qwen, 95% CI 15–58%), but each of the four intervals lies above 3% (this also holds with bias-corrected intervals and after a Holm correction). Their errors are concentrated in some clips: 5 or 6 of the 16 whispered clips fail (WER of 50% or more), and 2–4 are almost entirely lost (90% or more). In the other group, no whispered clip fails, and wrong words are the largest part of the error for every row except Gemini Smart, whose few errors are split about evenly between wrong and missing words.
blocks.zh: 在低声讲话时,Quen、Zoom和两个AAI模型都遗漏了26-32%的单词;其他每行最多漏出3%(图1)。 拥有16个剪辑的这些股份是不确定的(对Quen来说,95%的CI 15–58%),但四个间隔的每个间隔都在3%以上(这也带有偏差修正的间隔,并在Holm修正之后)。 他们的错误集中在一些剪辑中:16个低声剪辑中的5或6个失败(WER为50%或以上),2-4几乎完全丢失(90%或以上). 在另一组中,没有低语的剪辑失败,错误的词是每行错误的最大部分,只有双子智能例外,其少数错误在错误和缺失的词之间平分.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Whispered WER split into wrong, missing and extra words, as a share of all words; the number is the WER.
blocks.zh: 图1: Whispered WER分成错误的,缺失的和额外的单词,作为所有单词的共享;数字是WER.

blocks.en: Both AAI models cut off the last 3 or more words of 4 of the 16 whispered clips. Qwen’s missing stretches appear anywhere, including at the start. A cut-off ending leaves no visible gap in the text, and WER does not show it. AAI 3.6 (30.5%) and Zoom (34.7%) have similar whispered WER, but 4 of AAI 3.6’s whispered clips have a cut-off ending and none of Zoom’s (too few clips to test).
blocks.zh: 两个AAI模型都截断了16个低语片段中4个的最后3个或更多字. Wen失踪的拉伸处处都有, 截断结束在文本中没有留下明显的空白,WER没有显示. AAI 3.6 (30.5 %) 和 Zoom (34.7%) 也有类似的低语WER,但AAI 3.6 的低语短片中有 4 个有截断结局,没有Zoom的片段(太少的片段需要测试).

blocks.en: Qwen, Zoom and the AAI models all decide on the server when speech or a turn has ended, so a missing whispered word could be lost there rather than in recognition. This was tested on the 16 whispered clips (Appendix A ). For AAI, forcing the end of the last turn before closing the session changed nothing (AAI 3.6: 25.7% of words missing, then 25.6%), and turning end-of-turn detection off left 22.7% missing for AAI 3.6 and 25.7% for AAI 3.5. For Zoom, ending a segment after 5 s of silence instead of 600 ms lowered missing words from 27.6% to 21.2%. So AAI and, for the most part, Zoom lose these words whatever their turn settings; since the inside of a hosted service is not visible, this is counted as recognition, which here includes any speech detection inside the service. Qwen is different: our deployment runs its own speech detection before the model, with default settings, and relaxing it lowered Qwen’s missing words from 32.2% to 5.7%. Qwen’s whispered loss is therefore in the audio path of our own deployment, the level before the model, as for gated Whisper (Section 9 ). The relaxed setting did not raise WER on quiet or fan-on English or write text on silence (Appendix A ); the tables keep the deployment’s default.
blocks.zh: Quen,Zoom和AAI模型在语音或转弯结束时都会在服务器上决定,因此一个缺失的低语词可能会在那里丢失,而不是在识别中丢失. 这在16个低语片段(附录A)上进行了测试. 对于AAI来说,在结束会话前被迫结束最后转弯没有改变任何变化(AAI 3.6:25.7%的词缺失,然后25.6%),转弯检测结果使得AAI 3.6丢失22.7%,AAI 3.5丢失25.7%。 对于Zoom,在静默5秒后结束一段,而不是600毫秒将缺失的单词从27.6%降至21.2%。 因此,AAI以及大部分情况下,Zoom都会丢失这些单词,不管它们的转向设置如何;由于主机服务的内部不可见,这算作识别,这里包括服务内部的任何语音检测. Quen不同:我们的部署在模型之前运行自己的语音检测,设置默认,放松后将Quen的缺失词从32.2%降至5.7%. 因此,Quen的低声损失发生在我们自己部署的音频路径上,即模型之前的级别,以及门牌Whisper(第9节)。 放松的设置并没有在静默的或扇形的英语上提升WER,也没有在静默的文字上写入(附录A);表格保留了部署的默认值.

blocks.en: EARS [ 41 ] has 107 speakers recorded in a sound-proofed studio, reading the same passage (the Rainbow Passage) normally and in a whisper; parts 1–4 from every speaker are used, 428 normal and 428 whispered clips. Table 5 gives the results, scored as in Appendix E . Normal speech is easy for every system here (0.8–2.5%). Every speaker reads the same well-known passage, so EARS tests the same text across many voices, not unseen text (Section 11 ). Whispered, the same four systems again lose words, now 7–31% of them: AAI 3.6 and AAI 3.5 rise by about 7 points, Zoom by 24 and Qwen by 31 (with its deployment’s default speech detection, as in the tables). Whisper SH, which lost few words on our whispered clips, loses 10.4% of words as missing on EARS, against 7.3% for each AAI model (within chance), so the two groups of our in-house test are not a clean split across speakers. Gemini (in both settings), ElevenLabs (in both settings), Meta, GPT-Live and RT Whisper change by less than one point, and no speaker reaches a whispered WER of 20% with any of them.
blocks.zh: EARS[41]在一个隔音工作室中录制了107个扬声器,通常读同一段(彩虹通道)并用低语;使用每个扬声器的第1至第4部分,428个正常和428个低语片段. 表5按附录E所示列出结果。 正常的言语对于这里的每个系统来说都很简单(0.8–2.5%). 每个演讲者都读到同样众所周知的段落,因此EARS在许多声音中测试相同的文本,而不是隐形文本(第11节). 低调,同样的四个系统再次失语,现在为7-31%:AAI 3.6和AAI 3.5上升了约7分,放大了24分,奎恩上升了31分(随着部署的默认语音检测,如表中所示 ) 。 微声SH(Whisper SH)在微声短片上损失了几句话, 在EARS上损失了10.4%的词作为缺失, 而每个AAI模型(在机会范围内)损失了7.3%, 双子座(在两种情况下),11Labs(在两种情况下),Meta,GPT-Live和RT 微声变化小于1分,没有说话者与其中任何一位达到20%的低声WER.

blocks.en: Table 5: EARS: the same 107 speakers reading the same passage normally and whispered. WER (%), numbers and spellings normalised; 95% intervals from resampling speakers. Change: whispered minus normal, in points, paired by speaker and passage. Speakers ≥ \geq 20%: speakers whose whispered WER is 20% or more. Gated Whisper: gated Whisper with its VAD dropping audio (Section 9 ).
blocks.zh: 表5: EARS:同样107名发言者通常读同一段并低语。 WER(%),数字和拼写规范化;95%的间隔来自重印扬声器. 更改:低声减正常,以点数表示,以扬声器和通道对齐. 演讲者 ~\ geq 20%: 低声WER为20%或以上的演讲者。 Gated Whisper:用它的VAD降声(第9节.

blocks.en: 6.3 Named Entities
blocks.zh: 6.3 已命名的实体

blocks.en: Our English scripts name people, products and apps (for example, “send it to Maria” or “post it in Notion”). Over all English dictation, every system writes names correctly less often than other words (Table 6 ). Deepgram, used without its custom-vocabulary option, has the largest gap: 9.7 points (95% CI 3.3 to 16.7). Five more systems have gaps of 4.8–6.5 points with intervals that exclude zero, but these are 13 comparisons, and after a Holm correction only Deepgram’s gap remains clear. Names are 183 of 10,776 words, so even Deepgram’s gap adds only about 0.2 points to its WER: a system can write many names wrongly and still have a low WER. Much of the gap comes from fan-on and whispered messages. On quiet English alone (123 name words), no system’s gap is clearly above zero: Deepgram’s is the largest (6.4 points, 95% CI − 0.4 -0.4 to 14.7), and Whisper SH’s and Qwen’s fall from 6.5 to under 2 points.
blocks.zh: 我们的英文剧本给人、产品和应用程序取名(例如,“将其发送给Maria”或“张贴在Notion”中)。 在所有英语拼写中,每个系统正确写名字的频率都低于其他单词(表6). Deepgram在没有自定义-vocabulary选项的情况下使用,差距最大:9.7分(95% CI 3.3比16.7). 还有5个系统有4.8–6.5点的空隙,间隔时间排除0,但这是13个比较,在Holm校正后,只有Deepgram的空隙仍然清晰. 名称为10,776个单词中的183个,因此即使Deepgram的缺口也只给它的WER增加了约0.2分:一个系统可以错误地写出许多名称,并且仍然有一个低的WER. 大部分差距来自粉丝和低声留言。 仅凭安静的英语(123个名字单词),系统间隙没有明显高于零: Deepgram的成绩最大(6.4分,95%的CI−0.4-0.4至14.7),Whisper SH和Quen的成绩从6.5分下降到2分以下.

blocks.en: Of the 327 words capitalised in the middle of a sentence, only 156 are names, so the capital-letter rule alone finds names poorly; a written rule gives the 183 name words that are scored (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 在句子中间大写327个单词中,只有156个是名字,因此仅大写字母规则就发现名字不好;书面规则给出了被打分的183个单词(Appendix B ).

blocks.en: Table 6: Share of words written correctly (%) for the 183 name words and for all other words in English dictation, and the gap in percentage points, with its 95% confidence interval (bootstrap over the 106 messages).
blocks.zh: 表6:英文拼写中183个名称单词和所有其他单词的正确写法比例(%),以及百分比差距,其置信间隔为95%(106条信息被跳过)。

blocks.en: 6.4 Dialects and Shared Errors
blocks.zh: 6.4 对话框和共享错误

blocks.en: In the eleven other language sets, WER is below 5% on several European sets and near or above 50% on Emirati Arabic and, for some systems, Urdu. Almost all failed clips are in four sets: Saudi Arabic, Emirati Arabic, Hindi and Urdu (Appendix D , Table 18 ). Urdu and Hindi are about writing (Section 7.2 ); the Arabic dialects are about recognition.
blocks.zh: 在另外11套语言中,欧洲几套语言的WER低于5%,阿联酋阿拉伯语和某些系统乌尔都语的WER低于50%。 几乎所有失败的剪辑都分为四套:沙特阿拉伯语、埃米尔阿拉伯语、印地语和乌尔都语(附录D,表18)。 乌尔都语和印地语是关于写作(第7.2节);阿拉伯语方言是关于承认的.

blocks.en: Saudi and Emirati Arabic have failed clips for every one of the eleven systems: 15–35% and 50–75% of clips. On Emirati Arabic, WER is between 48.8% and 61.8% with default settings. Part of the error may come from the correct text itself: Arabic dialects have no standard spelling [ 28 ] , so a correct transcript can be spelled differently from ours.
blocks.zh: 沙特和阿联酋的阿拉伯语在11个系统中的每一个系统都失败了剪辑:15-35%和50-75%的剪辑。 在阿联酋阿拉伯语上,WER在48.8%到61.8%之间有默认设置. 部分错误可能来自正确的文本本身: 阿拉伯语方言没有标准的拼法[28],因此正确的拼法可以不同于我们的拼法.

blocks.en: If every system fails on a clip, switching systems will not help; if only one fails, another system avoids it. Of the 220 non-English clips, 21 are hard clips (WER above 30%) for all eleven systems: 14 Emirati Arabic, 6 Saudi Arabic and 1 Spanish (Spain). Across all 326 speech clips, 23 are hard for exactly one system (Appendix D ). In English, 67 of 73 quiet clips and all 17 fan-on clips are below 30% for every system, while 13 of 16 whispered clips are above it for at least one: for English, the choice of system matters most on whispered speech.
blocks.zh: 如果每个系统在一个剪辑上都失败,切换系统将无济于事;如果只有一个系统失败,另一个系统就会回避. 在220个非英语剪辑中,21个是硬剪辑(比30%以上),用于所有11个系统: 14 埃米尔阿拉伯语、6 沙特阿拉伯语和1 西班牙语(西班牙)。 在326个语音短片中,23个对一个系统来说很难(附录D)。 在英语中,73个静音片段中的67个和所有17个扇形片段的每个系统都低于30%,而16个低声片段中的13个至少有一个在它的上面: 对于英语来说,系统选择最要紧的是低声讲话.

blocks.en: 6.5 Far-Field and Noisy Speech
blocks.zh: 6.5 外地和噪音发言

blocks.en: VOiCES [ 47 ] replays audiobook sentences in a room and records them with a far microphone, in quiet, with several people talking (babble) and with a television playing. With babble, WER rises for every system, to between 38.7% and 94.9%, mostly as missing words; Zoom is lowest with babble and with television, although it is worse than average with a far microphone in a quiet room. Gemini returned no text within 30 seconds on 67 of the 100 babble clips, which count as empty transcripts; on the other 33 its WER is 40.3%, so most of its babble WER is a failure to answer rather than misrecognition. Appendix E gives the full results.
blocks.zh: VOICES [47] 在一个房间里重放音频本的句子,并用远麦克风录制,安静地,有几个人说话(bable),还有电视播放. 使用bulble,WER为每个系统提升到38.7%至94.9%之间,多为缺字;Zoom以bulble和电视为最低,尽管在静室用远麦克风比一般更糟糕. 双子座在100个bulble片断中的67个中,在30秒内没有返回文本,这些片断算作空盘;在另外33个中,它的WER为40.3%,所以其bulble WER大多是答不答,而不是误认. 附 录 E给出了全部结果.

blocks.en: 7 Output Formatting Errors
blocks.zh: 7 输出格式错误

blocks.en: 7.1 Number Formatting
blocks.zh: 7.1 数字格式

blocks.en: Most benchmarks convert numbers to a common form before scoring; here they are not converted, so each system’s ITN output is visible. The English scripts contain 276 numbers written in digits and 193 written as words (such as “first” or “twenty”). Qwen writes 68% of the digit numbers as words (“seven” for “7”), Meta 47% and GPT-Live 45%; the two AAI models do the opposite, turning 41–42% of number words into digits; Whisper SH, Gemini, Zoom and ElevenLabs usually keep the form in the script (Appendix D , Table 20 ). These switches make up 16.1% of GPT-Live’s English errors, 12.9% of Meta’s and 10.4% of Qwen’s, against 4.8–6.1% for ElevenLabs, Zoom and Whisper SH; a number written in several words counts once, so these shares are a minimum. The number itself was heard correctly.
blocks.zh: 大多数基准在打分前将数字转换为共同形式;在此不转换,因此每个系统的ITN输出可见. 英文剧本中包含276个数字,193个数字为单词(如“第一”或“二十”)。 Quen将数字数字的68%写成单词(“7”表示“7”),Meta 47%和GPT-Live 45%;两个AAI模型做相反的,将41-42%的数字单词变成数字;Whisper SH,双子座,Zom和11Labs通常保留脚本中的形式(附录D,表20). 这些开关占GPT-Live的英语错误的16.1%,Meta的12.9%和Quen的10.4%,而11Labs、Zoom和Whisper SH则占4.8-6.1%;用几个字写的数字算一次,所以这些股份是最低的。 号码本身被正确听到。

blocks.en: Re-scored after Whisper’s English text normaliser, which writes numbers as digits and removes fillers, every quiet-English WER falls, by 1.0–3.8 points when both scores use the same word splitting, but the order of systems changes little (rank correlation 0.98; Appendix D , Table 17 ). Number habits matter to a user who sees the text, but they are not what separates the systems on quiet English.
blocks.zh: 在Whisper的英文文本普通化(写数字为数字并去除填充器)之后,每一次静音-英语WER下降,当两个分数都使用同一个单词分数时,得分为1.0–3.8分,但系统的顺序变化不大(排名相关性0.98;附录D,表17). 数字习惯对看到文本的用户很重要,但它们不是将系统隔开在安静的英语上的原因.

blocks.en: 7.2 Writing System
blocks.zh: 7.2 书写系统

blocks.en: Urdu shows the biggest gap between systems, and the cause is mostly the writing system. Table 7 counts, for each system that writes Urdu in another script, the clips written mostly in Devanagari, the script of Hindi. Qwen, Meta and AAI 3.5 write most Urdu clips in Devanagari and fail on 85–95% of them. Meta and AAI 3.5 have no Urdu option and detect the language themselves; Qwen does this even when Urdu is selected. Spoken Urdu and Hindi are close, so a system detecting the language itself may reasonably hear Hindi; but a user who chose Urdu receives text in the wrong writing system, whatever words it contains. Zoom, which also has no Urdu option, writes 19 of 20 Urdu clips in Latin letters (“Ek bum governoral journal ke daftar…”) and fails on every one. Both Whisper rows, Deepgram, AAI 3.6 and ElevenLabs write in the Urdu writing system and fail on at most 5% of clips; RT Whisper has the lowest Urdu WER (12.3%).
blocks.zh: 乌尔都语显示出系统间最大的差距,原因主要是写作系统. 表7计算了每个用另一个脚本书写乌尔都语的系统, Quen,Meta和AAI 3.5在德瓦纳加里写下了大部分乌尔都语片段,并在其中85–95%上失败. Meta和AAI 3.5没有乌尔都语选项,并且检测语言本身;即使选择乌尔都语,Quen也会这样做. 乌尔都语和印地语很接近,因此一个检测语言本身的系统可能会合理听到印地语;但是选择乌尔都语的用户会收到错误的写作系统中的文本,无论它包含什么文字. Zom, 也无乌尔都语选项, 在拉丁字母中写下了20个乌尔都语剪辑中的19个(“Ek burk governoral journal ke daftar...”), Depgram,AAI 3.6和11Labs都写在乌尔都语的写作系统中,在最多5%的片断上失败;RT Whisper拥有最低的乌尔都语WER(12.3%).

blocks.en: Table 7: Urdu clips (of 20) written mostly in Devanagari, and Urdu clips with a WER of 50% or more. Gemini Smart writes some Devanagari on a fifth clip, and GPT-Live on 3 clips in all. Zoom writes 19 of 20 in Latin letters.
blocks.zh: 表7:乌尔都语片段(20集)主要用德瓦纳加里语写成,乌尔都语片段的WER比例为50%或以上. 双子智能在第五集中写下一些Devanagari,GPT-Live则总共写了3集. Zimo用拉丁字母写了20个中的19个.

blocks.en: Zoom has the highest Hindi WER of the eleven systems (34.6%), with text in the right writing system. Its CER (16.3%) is less than half its WER, so many of its wrong words differ from the correct word by a few characters, for example in vowel signs, rather than being different words (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: Zimo拥有11个系统中最高的印地语WER(34.6%),文本在右写系统中. 其CER(16.3%)还不到其WER的一半,因此其许多错误的单词与正确的单词因少数字符而不同,例如元音符号,而不是不同单词(Appendix D.).

blocks.en: 7.3 Disfluency Removal and Reference Choice
blocks.zh: 7.3 排除障碍和参考选择

blocks.en: The script reference asks whether the text is the message the user meant; the spoken reference asks whether the system heard what was said. A clean-up setting removes fillers, repeats and self-corrections on purpose, so it scores well on the first and loses points on the second. In the literature this is disfluency removal, and the choice between verbatim and clean transcripts [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 脚本参考文献询问文字是否是用户的意思;口语参考文献询问系统是否听到了所说的话. 清理设置会故意去除填充器,重复器和自修器,因此在第一作得分良好,在第二作失分. 在文献中,这是不光彩的去除,以及逐字记录和干净的录音记录的选择[50]。

blocks.en: Smart lowers Gemini’s quiet-English WER from 6.9% to 3.9%, and no_verbatim lowers ElevenLabs’ from 12.8% to 5.1%, in both cases almost all through fewer extra words (3.7% to 0.7%, and 8.1% to 1.4%).
blocks.zh: 智能将双子座的静态-英语WER从6.9%降至3.9 %,而No_verbatim将11Labs的静态-英语WER从12.8%降至5.1 %,在这两种情况下几乎都通过更少的额外词(3.7%降至0.7%,8.1%降至1.4%).

blocks.en: Table 8: English WER (%) against the script reference (as in Table 3 ) and against the spoken reference, with its 95% confidence interval (bootstrap over messages). Lower is better.
blocks.zh: 表8:英文WER(%)相对于脚本参考(如表3)和口语参考(95%的置信间隔(bootstrap over messages)). 低点更好

blocks.en: Table 8 scores the same transcripts against the spoken reference. Every system run at its verbatim default does better on quiet English, by 2.2–4.0 points, because words the reader added are no longer counted as extra. Gemini Smart is the only row that does worse (+0.8 points, paired 95% CI − 0.1 -0.1 to 1.6): it leaves out the repeats and self-corrections that are now in the reference. On quiet English, Gemini (3.7%), ElevenLabs NV (4.5%) and Gemini Smart (4.6%) are now close. In paired comparisons, Gemini is 0.9 points below Gemini Smart (95% CI − 1.8 -1.8 to 0.0), and Gemini Smart and ElevenLabs NV are 0.1 points apart. Against the script, Gemini Smart is clearly below ElevenLabs NV (by 1.2 points, 95% CI 0.6 to 1.9); against what was said, no clean-up setting is clearly ahead. The whispered results of Section 6.2 hold against either reference: every whispered WER moves by at most 1.5 points.
blocks.zh: 表8对照口语参考书目对相同的笔录进行评分。 每一个系统在逐字默认情况下运行,在安静的英语上都做得更好,比2.2–4.0点,因为读者添加的词不再算作额外词. 双子智能是唯一一个表现更糟糕的一行(+0.8分,对齐95%的CI − 0.1-0.1至1.6):它忽略了现在参考中的重复和自我修正. 在安静的英语中,双子座(3.7%),十一Labs NV(4.5%)和双子座Smart(4.6%)现已接近. 在配对比较中,双子座位于双子座Smart以下0.9分(95%的CI−1.8-1.8至0.0),双子座Smart和11Labs NV相差0.1分. 与剧本相反,双子智能明显低于11Labs NV(比1.2分,95%的CI 0.6比1.9);与之相反,没有明显的清理设置. 第6.2节的微声结果反对其中任何一种提法:每个微声的WER移动最多1.5点。

blocks.en: The spoken reference was drafted from where the verbatim systems agreed, so it could favour them. Each system voted for 237 to 313 of the 378 accepted edits. The reference was rebuilt eleven times, each time keeping only the accepted edits that the other ten systems would still have proposed. No system’s WER against its own rebuilt reference rose by more than 0.3 points in any condition. With the stricter thresholds used to pre-tick proposals, the largest rise was 1.2 points, for Meta on quiet English. But the order of Gemini, Gemini Smart and ElevenLabs NV is not stable. Without Gemini’s votes, Gemini is 0.5 points below Gemini Smart (95% CI − 1.3 -1.3 to 0.3); with the stricter pre-tick thresholds, it is 0.8 points above (95% CI − 0.1 -0.1 to 1.7). Neither difference is clear. A clean-up setting is clearly best only against the script.
blocks.zh: 口头提法是从逐字记录系统所同意的地方起草的,因此可以赞成这些提法。 每个系统投票支持378个接受编辑的237至313个. 参考书目重建了11次,每次只保留其他10个系统仍会提出的公认编辑. 任何系统对自身重建参考的WER在任何情况下都不超过0.3点。 由于使用更严格的门槛来预选提案,最大的涨幅是1.2分,因为Meta在静默的英语中. 但双子座,双子座智能座和十一Labs NV的顺序并不稳定. 没有双子座的选票,双子座比双子座Smart低0.5分(95% CI − 1.3-1.3至0.3);具有更严格的前置阈值,比前置阈值高出0.8分(95% CI − 0.1-0.1至1.7). 两者的区别都不明显。 清理设置显然只能与剧本相对立.

blocks.en: 8 Language Handling in Code-Switched Recordings
blocks.zh: 8 密码切换录音中的语言处理

blocks.en: The English-only setting is called a filter for a system when it loses the other language in more than half of the EN + X recordings, while the both-languages setting loses it in fewer than half. It is called a preference when the English-only setting itself loses the other language in fewer than half. By this rule, the setting is a filter for Gemini (in both settings), Deepgram and Whisper SH. They lose the non-English part in 86–99% of the 100 recordings with only English selected, against 33–46% with both selected (Table 25 , first column; Table 9 counts a loss of either part). It is a preference for Qwen, Meta, AAI 3.6, AAI 3.5, GPT-Live and RT Whisper, which lose it in 7–38%. Zoom and ElevenLabs (in both settings) lose most second languages whatever is selected, for reasons given below. Whether a filter is right depends on the app; a user who selects English and then says a sentence in another language may or may not want it written.
blocks.zh: 仅使用英语的设置,当在 EN + X 录音中超过半数丢失其他语言时,称为系统过滤器,而两种语言的设置在不到一半时都会丢失. 当只使用英语的设置本身在不到一半的时间里失去其他语言时,这被称为偏好. 根据这一规则,设置是双子座(在两种设置中),Deepgram和Whisper SH的过滤器. 在只有英文的100个录音中,他们损失了86-99%的非英文部分,而只有33-46%的英文部分(表25,第一栏;表9为其中任一部分的损失)。 其偏好是Quen,Meta,AAI 3.6,AAI 3.5,GPT-Live和RT Whisper,它们以7–38%的速度失去. Zoom和11Labs(在两种设置中)会失去大多数选择的第二语言,原因如下。 一个过滤器是否正确取决于应用程序;一个选择英语然后用另一种语言说句子的用户可能会或可能不希望它写入.

blocks.en: Our recordings are not natural code-switching [ 32 ; 33 ] : they join single-language recordings from different speakers, with a 300 ms pause between them, so the language, the speaker and the recording all change at a sentence boundary. One hundred recordings pair English with one of the 10 other language sets (EN + X), and 300 pair two non-English languages (X + Y). Urdu is left out because several systems write it in the wrong writing system even alone (Section 7.2 ). English comes first in half of the EN + X recordings, and the order of each X + Y pair is balanced likewise. Each recording is played with both languages selected and with automatic detection, and EN + X recordings also with only English selected. All eleven systems were run on this test.
blocks.zh: 我们的录音不是自然的密码交换[32;33]: 他们加入了来自不同发言者的单语录音,在他们之间暂停300ms,所以语言,扬声器和录音在句子边界上的所有变化. 100个录音配对英语与其他10个语言集之一(EN + X),300个配对两种非英语语言(X + Y). 乌尔都语被忽略了,因为有多个系统甚至单独写错(第7.2节). 英语在EN + X录音中排在第一位,每对X + Y的顺序也是平衡的. 每张录音都使用所选的两种语言进行播放,并进行自动检测,EN + X录音也只使用所选的英语. 所有11个系统都在测试中运行。

blocks.en: To score a recording, the transcript is lined up with the two parts’ correct texts joined end to end, and each reference word is marked as heard, replaced or missing. A part is missing when less than 20% of its words are heard: either nothing is written in its place, or other text is. Table 9 gives the share of recordings in which a part goes missing. A part may also go missing because it is hard on its own; on a screened subset of recordings whose parts every system gets mostly right alone, the order of the systems is almost the same and the conclusions do not change (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 为了获得录音的分数,笔录与两部分的正确文本一起排成一行,结尾为一行,每个参考词被标记为听觉、替换或缺失。 当听到不到20%的文字时,一部分就不见了:要么没有文字代替,要么有其他文字。 表9列出了缺失部分录音的比例。 一部分可能也会因为自身困难而丢失;在一个经过筛选的录音子集上,每个系统的大部分部分都是靠右进行的,系统顺序几乎相同,结论也不改变(附录F.

blocks.en: Table 9: Share of two-language recordings (%) in which one of the two languages went missing; lowest in each column in bold. EN + X: 100 recordings of English and another language; X + Y: 300 recordings of two other languages. For shares between 25% and 75%, the 95% interval is about ± \pm 12–22 points for EN + X and ± \pm 8–11 points for X + Y, wide because recordings reuse source clips (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 表9:两种语言中缺少一种语言的录音的比例(%);每栏中以粗体表示的比例最低。 EN + X:英语和另一种语言的100个录音;X + Y:另外两种语言的300个录音. 对于25%至75%的股份,95%的间隔大约为±\pm 12–22分的 EN + X 和±\pm 8–11分的 X + Y ,由于录制回用源剪辑(附录B)而宽.

blocks.en: Table 25 (Appendix F ) shows which part goes missing and what appears in its place. Meta never loses the first part, in any setting; all of its losses are the second part. Gemini does the opposite: with automatic detection, it loses the first part in 54% of EN + X recordings and the second in 19%, and the lost part is the English one in 37 of the 100. GPT-Live loses a part in 6–7% of EN + X recordings, almost always the second. Qwen also loses the second part more often than the first (14% against 6% of EN + X recordings with both languages selected, and 101 against 37 of the 300 X + Y); in 14 of its 20 EN + X losses it writes other text in the lost part’s place. Whisper SH usually leaves a gap: with both languages selected, it loses the first part in 25% of recordings and the second in 20%, and in 43% nothing is written where the part should be.
blocks.zh: 表25(附录F)显示缺失的部分和出现的地方。 Meta从未在任何场合失去第一部分;其所有损失都是第二部分. 双子座则相反:随着自动检测,它损失了EN + X录制的54%的第一部分和19%的第二部分,丢失的部分是100分中37分中的英语部分. GPT-Live在 EN + X 录制的 6–7% 中失去了一部分,几乎总是第二个. Quen也比第一部更经常地失去第二部分(以两种语言选择的EN + X录音的14%对6%),以及300 X + Y 中的 101 对 37 ; 在它的20 EN + X 损失的 14 份中,它将其他文本写在丢失的部分。 Whisper SH通常会留下一个漏洞:随着两种语言的选择,在25%的录音中会失去第一部分,在20%的录音中会失去第二部分,而在43%的录音中不会写出该部分应该写的地方.

blocks.en: Deepgram rarely leaves a gap. Instead, in 34% of the 50 EN + X recordings whose other language has its own writing system (Arabic, Hindi or Mandarin), it writes that part in Latin letters, mostly Arabic and Mandarin parts as strings of similar-sounding Latin syllables. Gemini, with both languages selected, writes the Hindi part in Latin letters in 5 of the 10 recordings of English and Hindi. A real English translation is mainly a Whisper behaviour, as reported for code-switched speech [ 7 ] : Whisper SH, with only English selected, translates the other part into English in 18% of these recordings. A check for missing text does not find romanised or translated parts.
blocks.zh: Deepgram很少留下缺口. 相反,在50种EN + X录音中,有34%的其他语言有自己的写作系统(阿拉伯语、印地语或普通话),它用拉丁字母写下这一部分,大部分是阿拉伯语和普通话部分,作为类似音节的拉丁音节的字符串。 在英语和印地语的10个录音中, 真正的英文翻译主要是Whisper行为, 仅选择英语的Whisper SH将这些录音的18%翻译成英语. 缺少文本的检查找不到罗马化或翻译的部分 。

blocks.en: Zoom took one language per session, so all three settings behave like English only: it loses a language in 62% of EN + X recordings and 85% of X + Y. Its Arabic, Hindi and Mandarin parts are lost in every recording, while most Spanish, German and French parts survive (43 of 130, 7 of 110 and 19 of 110 lost, with both languages selected). ElevenLabs, by default, finalises the whole recording as one block of text. It loses a part in 62% of EN + X recordings (almost always the non-English part) and 93% of X + Y; ElevenLabs NV in 80% and 96%. Set to finalise at each 300 ms pause, the gap placed between the two clips, ElevenLabs lost far fewer languages (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: Zimo每场均使用1种语言,因此所有三种设置都只表现为英语:在 EN + X 的62%的录音中失去1种语言,在 X + Y 的85%中失去1种语言. 其阿拉伯语,印地语和普通话部分在每场录音中都丢失,而大多数西班牙语,德语和法语部分则幸存下来(130位中的43位,110位中的7位和110位中的19位,同时选择了两种语言). 11Labs默认将整个录制成一个块的文本. 它在 EN + X 录音(几乎总是非英语部分)中失去了一部分,在 X + Y 中失去了93%;在 11Labs NV 中损失了80%和96%. 设定在每300 ms暂停时完成,两个片段之间的间隙,11Labs丢失的语言要少得多(Appendix F.

blocks.en: 9 Audio Handling Before the Model: A Whisper Case Study
blocks.zh: 9 音频处理 模式前:微声案例研究

blocks.en: Whisper is a widely used open ASR model. Unlike the hosted services in this paper, it works on 30-second windows, so live use needs a growing buffer [ 51 ] or cutting at pauses [ 52 ] , and it leaves several choices to whoever runs it: where it is hosted, how the audio is cut into segments, and whether a VAD drops audio before the model hears it. On whispered speech, these choices changed our results more than the choice between most systems did. This section describes the setups tried and what each choice did in this test.
blocks.zh: 微声是一种广泛使用的开放ASR模型. 与本文中主机服务不同的是,它工作在30秒窗口上,所以直播使用需要不断增长的缓冲[51]或者在暂停[52]时剪切,它留给运行它的人几个选择:它的主机位置,音频如何切成片段,一个VAD是否在模型听到它之前就丢掉音频. 在悄悄的演讲中,这些选择比大多数系统之间的选择更改变了我们的结果。 本节介绍所尝试的设置以及每个选择在这个测试中所做的.

blocks.en: Table 10 lists them. Setups 1–6 run Whisper Large V3 on two deployments of ours. OpenAI does not say which Whisper version it serves for setups 7–9; at its 2023 launch it described its Whisper API model as Large V2 [ 53 ] , so differences between setups 1–6 and 7–9 may come from the model version as well as from how it is run. Appendix G gives the exact rules of each setup.
blocks.zh: 表10列出了这些表格。 设置1 -6运行Whisper大V3 在我们的两次部署。 OpenAI没有说它服务于哪个Whisper版本的设置7–9;它在2023年的发布会上将它的Whisper API模型描述为大V2[53],因此设置1–6和7–9之间的区别可能来自模型版本以及其运行方式. 附 录 G给出了每个设置的确切规则.

blocks.en: Table 10: The nine ways of running Whisper. Setups 1–2 and 3–6 are two different deployments of Whisper Large V3; setups 7–9 are OpenAI’s hosted Whisper.
blocks.zh: 表10:运行华声的九种方式. 设置1–2和3–6是Whisper大型V3的两种不同的部署;设置7–9是OpenAI的主机Whisper.

blocks.en: Table 11 compares the nine on the same clips.
blocks.zh: 表11比较了同一片段上的9个.

blocks.en: Table 11: Nine ways of running Whisper for dictation. Error rates in %, lower is better; the lowest in each row is in bold. † Average over 10 language sets, not counting Urdu. Lost a language: share of all two-language recordings (100 EN + X and 300 X + Y) in which one language went missing, with both languages selected. Gated Whisper ran the two-language test with its VAD on only.
blocks.zh: 表11:拼音的9种运行方式. 误差率以%计,较低者更好;每行最低者用粗体表示。 † 平均超过10种语言,不包括乌尔都语. 失去一种语言:所有两种语言录音(100 EN + X和300 X + Y)中缺少一种语言的部分,选择两种语言. Gated Whisper只用VAD进行双语测试.

blocks.en: With its VAD on, the gated deployment has a whispered WER of 80.7%, and the VAD never sent 2 of the 16 whispered clips. Turning the VAD off lowers whispered WER by 19.6 points (95% CI 7.0 to 36.9) and changes quiet and fan-on English by less than a point (Appendix G , Table 26 ). The self-hosted deployment shows the same effect from the other side: sent all of the audio, its whispered WER is 10.1%; with Silero dropping audio, 51.4%, with 44.6% of words missing. Both effects hold across the 107 EARS speakers. Turning the gated deployment’s VAD off lowers whispered WER by 10.1 points (95% CI 8.0 to 12.2). Silero dropping audio raises the self-hosted deployment’s by 26.8 points (95% CI 21.3 to 32.2), and puts 62 of the 107 speakers at 20% or more, against 20 (Table 27 ).
blocks.zh: 随着VAD的开机,闸机部署有80.7%的微声WER,VAD从未发送过16个微声片段中的2个. 将 VAD 关闭 低音 WER 以 19.6 分(95% CI 7.0 到 36.9) 低音 WER , 并 更改 静音 和 fan-on 英语 不到 点( Appendix G , 表 26 ) 。 自备部署显示来自对方的同样效果:发送所有音频,其低声WER为10.1%;Silero降音为51.4%,缺字为44.6%. 这两种效果都贯穿了107个欧洲遥感系统发言者。 门卫部署的VAD在下方低声传出10.1分(95%CI 8.0比12.2)WER. Silero投放音频使自备的部署提高了26.8分(95%的CI 21.3至32.2),107位发言者中有62位达到或超过20%,而20位(表27)。

blocks.en: When the VAD only cuts the audio, Silero and TEN give nearly the same results (whispered 10.1% and 10.2%). When it also drops audio, they differ sharply: with Silero, whispered WER rises to 51.4%; with TEN, it stays at 10.7%. On EARS, dropping with Silero gives 38.3% and dropping with TEN 14.4%, against 11.5% for sending all of the audio; TEN’s rise of 2.9 points is within chance (95% CI − 0.4 -0.4 to 6.7). TEN keeps whispered speech because it calls most of it speech: 79% of whispered 32 ms windows at its default threshold, against 37% for Silero. It does not call steady noise speech any more than Silero does, but it calls more background talk speech (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 当VAD只剪辑音频时,Silero和TEN给出了几乎相同的结果(Whispered 10.1%和10.2%). 当它也降低音频时,它们差异很大:随着Silero,低声WER上升至51.4%;随着TEN,它停留在10.7%. 在EARS中,与Silero一起下降给出38.3%,与TEN相比下降14.4%,而发送所有音频的TEN为11.5%;TEN上升2.9分的可能性不大(95%的CI−0.4-0.4到6.7). TEN一直低声说话,因为它把大部分的语音称为:79%的低声32ms窗口处于默认阈值,而Silero为37%. 它不比Silero更叫稳定噪音演说,而是叫更多的背景谈话演说(Appendix G.

blocks.en: Even at a threshold of 0.2, Silero’s whispered WER stays at 41.1%, while TEN’s stays at 10.0–10.7% at every threshold tried (Appendix G , Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 即便在0.2的临界点,Silero的微声WER仍然停留在41.1%,而TEN则停留在每一次试验的10.0-10.7%(附录G,图2)。

blocks.en: Whisper can write text that was never said (hallucination) [ 55 ; 56 ] . On all 10 no-speech clips Whisper-1 wrote text, mostly “you” and “Thank you for watching.”, and the self-hosted deployment wrote a stray “.” or “so” on 6 of 10. On two short Spanish (Spain) clips the self-hosted deployment replaced the whole speech with a stock phrase such as “Muchas gracias.” Dropping audio with a VAD removes text on silence, at the cost above.
blocks.zh: Whisper可以写出从未说过的文字(吸血)[55;56]. 在全部10个无声短片上,Whisper-1写下了文字,大多是“你”和“谢谢你的观看”,自办的部署在10分之6上写了一个“如此”或“如此”。 在两段短短的西班牙语(西班牙)中, 使用 VAD 丢弃音频会删除沉默的文字, 成本为以上 。

blocks.en: Whisper-1, which transcribes the whole recording after the user stops, has the lowest quiet and whispered English WER of the nine setups (5.5% and 7.7%), but a typical wait of 1,850 ms and text on every no-speech clip. RT Whisper is the most accurate on the other languages (14.0% average, against 17.3–18.9%) and loses a language in 11% of two-language recordings, but accepts only one language and waits about twice as long as the self-hosted deployment (735 ms against 361 ms typical).
blocks.zh: Whisper-1在用户停播后将整个录音进行转录,在9个设置(5.5%和7.7%)中,音响最低且低声的英语WER,但在每段无声片段上却有1,850 ms和文本的典型等待. 中文组 低声在其他语言上最为准确(平均为14.0%,对17.3–18.9 %),在两种语言的录音中损失了11%的语言,但只接受一种语言,并等待大约两倍于自备部署(735 ms对361 ms的典型).

blocks.en: With its VAD off, the gated deployment still has a whispered WER of 61.1%, almost all of it missing words; the self-hosted deployment, which transcribes the segments the client cuts at pauses, misses 1.8% of whispered words (10.4% on EARS). The two are different deployments, so this does not isolate how the audio is cut (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 随着VAD的关闭,闸门部署仍然有61.1%的低声WER,几乎所有的WER都缺少单词;自办部署在暂停时将客户端截断的片段转录,错过了1.8%的低声单词(EARS为10.4%). 两者是不同的部署,因此这并不孤立音频的剪切方式(Appendix G ).

blocks.en: 10 Recommendations for Evaluating Dictation ASR
blocks.zh: 10 关于评估字迹的建议 ASR

blocks.en: Systems with similar error rates made different kinds of errors in our test, at every level of the taxonomy. Tests of ASR systems for dictation should include the following. • Recognition: report wrong, missing and extra words separately , with missing stretches and cut-off endings (Sections 6.1 and 6.2 ). Test whispered speech with several speakers. Report accuracy on names separately, because a gap of 1 point and one of 10 look almost the same in overall WER, and check which words are names (Section 6.3 ). • Output formatting: say which reference is used , and score against both what the speaker meant and what they said when clean-up settings are compared (Section 7.3 ). Check how numbers are written (Section 7.1 ) and the writing system of the output, especially for languages written in more than one (Section 7.2 ). • Language handling: test two-language speech under each language setting , and tell missing, romanised and translated parts apart (Section 8 ). Settings that seem unrelated to language can matter: ElevenLabs lost far fewer languages when it finalised text at each pause. • Before the model: test the whole app , including any VAD and how the audio is cut, on whispered speech and on silence (Section 9 ). • Separate errors all systems share from errors one system makes. Errors every system makes, such as on Saudi and Emirati Arabic, will not be fixed by switching among the tested systems (Section 6.4 ).

blocks.en: 11 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 11 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The study compares systems on the same audio under controlled conditions, and that design sets its scope. Each point below is also a direction that the released code and data support. • Speakers and speech style. The in-house English is 106 scripted messages from one speaker. This keeps the voice constant, so differences between systems and conditions are not confounded with the speaker; the reader varied accent deliberately. Read speech has fewer and different disfluencies than spontaneous dictation, which matters most for the clean-up results. The EARS and VOiCES results extend the main findings to 107 and 100 speakers; spontaneous dictation from many speakers, recorded and scored with the same pipeline, is the natural next step. • Set sizes. With 16 whispered messages and 20 clips per language set, the full matrix of systems, settings and languages stays tractable. The tables are best read as patterns, with the intervals given; the differences called clear hold after correction for multiple comparisons. Larger sets per language would tighten the estimates for individual languages. • Corpora. Each dialect set comes from a single public corpus, so dialect and recording source are not separated. The external corpora are read speech with public texts (EARS uses one well-known passage, VOiCES uses LibriSpeech [ 57 ] ), so a system may have seen them in training, which could flatter clean scores and help on the whispered EARS passage. A second corpus per dialect and unseen whispered text would separate these effects. • References and labels. The spoken reference keeps every departure from the script that the systems heard and a listener confirmed; a departure no system heard stays as scripted, and fillers are left out, as in the scripts. Most analyses use the script, which favours clean-up settings on extra words, so Section 7.3 reports both. Names were labelled by a language model (Claude) following a written rule, accents by a classifier checked against the reader’s account, and romanised and translated parts by rules checked by hand on examples. The thresholds in Table 1 are stated so that others can vary them, and a fully hand-annotated verbatim reference would extend the comparison. • Configuration. Each system runs at its defaults, with the changes in Appendix A , so the results describe systems as a developer first meets them. Where a setting could change a conclusion, it was tested directly: end-of-turn detection, regional language codes, GPT-Live’s delay (Table 14 ), ElevenLabs’ pause finalising and the nine Whisper setups. The Whisper setups in the main comparison were chosen using Section 9 , and GPT-Live’s delay on 50 English test clips, with both settings reported. Further settings to explore include ElevenLabs’ pause finalising on single-language audio, gated Whisper’s two-language runs without its VAD, Zoom settings beyond its sample app, and repeated runs of the VAD threshold sweep. • Streaming behaviour. The finalised text is scored and the wait for it measured, which is what a dictation user receives. Partial text and its stability [ 24 ] , and endpointing decided by the system itself, are separate questions the released client can be extended to measure. • Hosted systems change. Results reflect the hosted services in October 2026, tested from one client location. Each clip was played once per system and setting; a replay a week later gave near-identical results (Appendix A ). Because the client and scoring are released, the comparison can be rerun as services change.

blocks.en: 12 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 12. 结论

blocks.en: The same audio was streamed to eleven ASR systems, and every error was grouped by the level it shows up at. Systems with similar error rates failed differently at every level. In recognition, some systems left out a large share of whispered words that the others heard, and the pattern largely held across 107 external speakers; names were written correctly less often than other words. In output formatting, systems differed in how they wrote numbers and in which writing system, and clean-up settings wrote the message meant rather than every word said. In language handling, selecting only English removed the other language for some systems and only guided it for others. Before the model, how the app detected speech and dropped audio decided much of the whispered-speech result, for Whisper and for our Qwen deployment. Some errors, such as those on Saudi and Emirati Arabic, are made by every system. These error types should be reported alongside WER, and the app’s whole audio path should be tested.
blocks.zh: 同样的音频被流到11个ASR系统,每一个错误都按其显示的级别分组. 错误率相近的系统在每个级别都以不同方式失败。 为了承认这一点,有些系统漏掉了大部分别人听到的低语,107个外部发言者基本上掌握了这种模式;地名的写法比其他词要正确。 在输出格式化中,系统在写数字的方式和写作系统上存在差异,清理设置是写信息的意思而不是每个单词的意思. 在语言处理中,只选择英语为一些系统去除其他语言,而只指导其他系统. 在模型之前,应用程序如何检测语音和投放音频决定了许多低语的语音结果,用于Whisper和我们的Quen部署. 每个系统都有一些错误,例如沙特语和阿联酋阿拉伯语的错误。 这些错误类型应该与 WER 一起报告, 并且应该测试应用程序的整个音频路径 。

blocks.en: Ethics
blocks.zh: 道德操守

blocks.en: The English dictations were recorded by one member of our team, who volunteered to read scripted messages for this study. They consented to the use of their recordings for it and to their public release, and the consent is kept on record by the authors. The scripts were written for the study, and the people they name are invented, except that three email scripts are signed with the name of one of the authors, who agreed to this; the scripts contain no other personal data. No audio or text from users of any product is included. Because the test streams audio to hosted ASR services, the recordings were processed by those providers under their terms of service. The public clips are used under their licences. EARS (CC BY-NC 4.0) and VOiCES (CC BY 4.0) are used for non-commercial research evaluation only. No data from this study, and no transcript returned by a tested system, was used to train any model; the systems’ transcripts were used only to score them and to draft the spoken references (Section 4 ).

blocks.zh: 附录 A 系统配置

blocks.en: Each system is used with its default settings, with these changes. Deepgram has punctuate and smart_format on. GPT-Live uses delay low . Whisper SH decodes with beam width 5, is given both languages when two are selected, and has its audio cut into segments by the client (Section 9 ). ElevenLabs writes verbatim text and finalises once, when the audio ends. blocks.en: The 16 whispered clips were also run with: AAI sending ForceEndpoint before Terminate ; AAI with end-of-turn detection off ( end_of_turn_confidence_threshold 1, max_turn_silence 10 s); Zoom with silence_duration_ms 5,000 instead of 600; and Qwen with our server’s speech detection relaxed (threshold 0.3, 2,000 ms of silence, 300 ms padding). The relaxed Qwen setting had no measurable cost: on the 46 quiet and 14 fan-on messages that completed (the longest timed out on our single server), WER was 10.3% against 11.3% with the default, and 5.6% against 6.3%, and it wrote no text on the 10 no-speech clips. Results are in Section 6.2 .

blocks.en: Audio is sent at the speed of speech in 32 ms chunks at 16 kHz (24 kHz for Meta, GPT-Live and RT Whisper; 100 ms chunks for AAI, which rejected chunks under 50 ms, and Zoom). At the end the client signals end of audio and waits up to 30 seconds for the final text. Each clip uses a new session, from one client machine, with our own WebSocket code rather than vendor SDKs. Repeatability was checked on 42 clips played a week apart: gated Whisper and Gemini returned the same text, and Meta’s WER was 16.5% and 16.7% (on the 41 clips it answered). Tables 12 and 13 give each system’s model and settings; anything not listed is the provider’s default.

blocks.en: The eleven systems’ verbatim transcripts were aligned with the script, and an edit was proposed wherever enough systems heard the same departure: an added word when at least three did, a missing or changed word when at least five did (higher, because four systems drop the same whispered words). Proposals with at least four or six votes were pre-ticked. One team member listened to every message, accepted or rejected each proposal, and corrected six messages by hand. Complete words were kept as spoken, including self-corrected ones; cut-off fragments and fillers were left out, as in the scripts.
blocks.zh: 这11个系统的逐字记录稿与脚本一致,只要有足够的系统听到同样的发音,就提议编辑:至少三个系统听到一个增加的单词,至少五个系统听到一个增加的单词缺失或更改的单词(更高,因为四个系统会掉下同一个低语的单词)。 至少有四或六票的提案被预先选中。 一名小组成员聆听了每个信息,接受或否决了每个建议,并用手更正了六个信息。 完整的词句被保留为口语,包括自我修正的词句;像脚本一样,没有留下截断的片段和填充符.

blocks.en: A difference is clear only if its paired 95% interval excludes zero and its two-sided bootstrap p-value stays below 0.05 after a Holm correction within its group. The 17 groups are listed in paper/analysis/stats_review.ts (4,000 resamples) and gptdelay.py (2,000): each English condition’s best against next-best system; the whispered missing-word shares; the name gaps; script against spoken reference; the clean-up settings; ElevenLabs NV on Saudi and Emirati Arabic; English-only against both languages; ElevenLabs finalising; the Whisper setups (in-house and EARS); the EARS and VOiCES condition changes; and GPT-Live’s delay settings. Two-language tests resample source clips (Section 8 ). Differences outside these groups, such as the language averages, are not called clear.
blocks.zh: 只有当其组合95%的间隔排除0,且其双侧靴子p值在其组内修正后保持在0.05以下时,差异才明显。 这17个组在纸/分析/stats_review.ts(4,000 resamples)和gptdelay.py(2,000)中列出:每个英文条件最优于次佳系统;低声缺失的字数份额;名称空白;文字与口语参考;清理设置;沙特语和阿联酋阿拉伯语上的11Labs NV;英语只针对两种语言;11Labs定稿;Whispers设置(内部和ELS);EARS和VOiCES条件变化;以及GPT-Live的延迟设置. 两种语言的测试重新模拟源片段(第8节 ). 这些群体以外的差异,例如语言平均值,称为不明确。

blocks.en: Capital letters and punctuation are ignored. For Arabic and Urdu, short-vowel marks and the elongation character are removed; for Arabic, the following are also merged: alif with and without hamza , ta marbuta with ha , and alif maqsura with ya . Traditional and simplified Chinese characters count as equal.
blocks.zh: 大写字母和标注被忽略. 对阿拉伯语和乌尔都语来说,短沃尔标记和延寿字符被删除;对阿拉伯语来说,以下几处也被合并:alif 与hamza 和没有hamza ,ta marbuta 与 ha ,以及alif maqsura 与 ya 。 传统和简化的汉字算作平等.

blocks.en: With no spaces, each Chinese character and each run of Latin letters or digits counts as one unit: the mixed error rate (MER) of Mandarin–English code-switching work [ 34 ] , not the match error rate of Morris et al. [13] . Chinese numerals in place of digits count as errors.
blocks.zh: 没有空格,每个中文字符和每个拉丁字母或数字的运行算为一个单位: 普通话的混合误差率(MER) – 英文代码切换工作[34],而不是莫里斯等人的匹配误差率. [13] (中文(简体) ). 中国数字代替数字计为错误.

blocks.en: Most are read sentences (FLEURS and Puerto Rican Spanish); the Saudi and Emirati sets are dialect speech, and Spanish (Spain) is European Parliament speech.
blocks.zh: 大部分是读音(FLEURS和波多黎各西班牙语);沙特语和埃米尔语是方言,西班牙语(西班牙)是欧洲议会的演讲.

blocks.en: Each of the 184 different capitalised words was labelled by a written rule: names of people, organisations, products, services, programming languages, places and titled works count; days, months, titles, job titles, acronyms, headings and ordinary capitalised words do not. Only 156 of the 327 capitalised words are names. Adding 22 occurrences of listed names that the capital-letter rule misses (sentence starts, after “Dr.”) and 5 lower-case uses of a listed product name gives 183.
blocks.zh: 184个不同的大写词都用书面规则贴上标签:人、组织、产品、服务、编程语言、地点和标题的作品名称;天数、月份、标题、职称、缩写、标题和普通大写词没有。 327个大写字中只有156个是名字. 加上大写字母规则中遗漏的22个列名(判决开始,在“Dr.”之后)和5个小写使用上市产品名称的情况,使183人受益。

blocks.en: Each recording was split into 4-second windows, which were labelled with the CommonAccent classifier [ 58 ] , keeping windows with a top-class probability of at least 0.7. On the 90 spoken messages, 62% of windows are US English, 29% South Asian English and 7% British, New Zealand or Irish. Labels change between consecutive windows 28% of the time, against 4% on EARS, whose speakers each keep one accent; the reader confirmed the mix was deliberate. Whispered messages are 98% US English, so the classifier hears no accent in whispers. Messages labelled mostly South Asian (25 of 90) have about the same WER as the rest for every system, but 16 of them are fan-on messages, so accent and condition cannot be separated.
blocks.zh: 每段录音被分为4秒窗口,这些窗口被贴上CommonAccent分类器[58]的标签,保持窗口的顶级概率至少为0.7. 在90条口语留言中,62%的窗口是美国英语,29%是南亚英语,7%是英国,新西兰或爱尔兰语. 标签在28%的时间里在连续窗口之间变化,在EARS上则有4%,其扬声器各保留一个口音;读者确认混合是故意的. 低声留言为98%的美国英语,因此分类者在低声留言中不会听到重音. 大部分标注为南亚语(90种中的25种)的訊息与每个系统其余的WER大致相同,但其中16种是扇形訊息,因此口音和条件无法分离.
